name: 响应速度
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="13 2 3 14 12 14 11 22 21 10 12 10 13 2"/></svg>
description: 在底部状态栏实时显示当前对话最新请求与平均 AI 响应速度（TTFT），每个对话独立记录，支持 AI 自循环每次独立测速，点击底栏可查看当前对话的统计明细看板与历史记录。
descriptionEn: Real-time tracking of AI response speed (TTFT) for the current conversation showing both latest and average in the bottom status bar, with independent records per conversation and per AI turn/self-loop, and click-to-view details dashboard.
